title: ID0423543-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S2 170003121]update all Tank&Rast chargers
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: Please update all Tank&Rast chargers in this location to FW 6.1.3. If you search in SCB for "A7 Feuchtwangen", you will find 14 chargers, 12 of which should be online. As the location is not open to the public yet, you can update the chargers at all times. Based on Ingo Oldenburgs feedback, the SIM Card APN also needs to be updated for some chargers. In case of questions, please reach out to him.
Solution: N/A
yyyy-mm-dd: 2025-05-09
